text_content:
Your Privacy Choices
As described in our Privacy Policy, we collect personal information from your interactions with us and our website, including through cookies and similar technologies. We may also share this personal information with third parties, including advertising partners. We do this in order to show you ads on other websites that are more relevant to your interests and for other reasons outlined in our privacy policy.
Sharing of personal information for targeted advertising based on your interaction on different websites may be considered "sales", "sharing", or "targeted advertising" under certain U.S. state privacy laws. Depending on where you live, you may have the right to opt out of these activities. If you would like to exercise this opt-out right, please follow the instructions below.
If you visit our website with the Global Privacy Control opt-out preference signal enabled, depending on where you are, we will treat this as a request to opt-out of activity that may be considered a “sale” or “sharing” of personal information or other uses that may be considered targeted advertising for the device and browser you used to visit our website.

text_content:
Sell Your Cards | PTC Collectibles
Welcome to PTC Collectibles - Your Trusted Source for Bulk Pokémon Card Sales!
Looking to sell your Pokémon card collection in bulk? Look no further! At PTC Collectibles, we specialize in buying large quantities of Pokemon cards, offering competitive prices and a hassle-free selling experience. Whether you're a collector looking to downsize or a store looking to liquidate excess inventory, we've got you covered.
With our extensive knowledge and experience in the Pokémon card market, we understand the value and demand for different card sets, including rare and highly sought-after editions. Our team of experts meticulously evaluates each card to provide you with the best possible offer, ensuring that you receive a fair and accurate assessment of your collection's worth.
Selling to PTC Collectibles is easy and convenient. Simply fill out our online form or give us a call to provide details about your Pokémon card collection, such as the set, condition, and quantity. Our friendly and professional team will guide you through the process, answering any questions you may have and providing a quick and transparent appraisal.
We pride ourselves on offering competitive rates for bulk purchases, allowing you to maximize the value of your Pokémon card collection. Once we reach an agreement, we'll handle all the logistics, including packaging and shipping. Rest assured that your cards will be well-protected during transit, and you'll receive prompt payment upon verification of the received items.
At PTC Collectibles, we prioritize customer satisfaction and aim to make the selling process as smooth as possible. Our reputation for integrity, reliability, and exceptional customer service sets us apart as a trusted partner in the Pokémon card community. Join countless sellers who have had a positive experience with us, turning their collections into cash with ease.
If you're ready to sell your Pokémon card collection in bulk, choose PTC Collectibles as your preferred buyer. Get in touch with us today to discover the value of your collection and embark on a rewarding selling journey. Turn those unused cards into cash and let us take care of the rest!
Sell us your Pokémon Bulk by filling out the form below:
PayPal or Store Credit payments for bulk.
Current prices we pay (CAD):
Pokémon (English or Japanese):

$0.10 each Holo Rare

How the Bulk works!

"Bulk" is considered to be any Pokémon card that is:
- English
- Near Mint
- NOT an energy (special energy is fine!)
- Not counterfeit
- No world champ cards
- Trainers DO count as bulk
If you send your cards in a jumbled mix (not commons with commons, holos with holos, etc.), you will be paid the lowest rate. We are not sorting your cards for you. Please do so yourself if you want to be paid appropriately.
